# ModifiedFamilyVicsekScaling

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
An extension of the standard Family-Vicsek scaling relation that accounts for anomalous roughening exponents and non-standard growth regimes in interface dynamics. Enables precise characterization of spatiotemporal correlations in distributed computing networks, aiding in predicting performance degradation or synchronization failures.
